blocked.reason: The catalog describes recordings but provides neither individual locators nor content.
blocked.needed_to_unblock: An authorized later retrieval must enumerate recordings and record item-level provenance and access status.

blocked.reason: The catalog describes lecture notes or slides but provides neither individual locators nor content.
blocked.needed_to_unblock: An authorized later retrieval must enumerate the files and record item-level provenance and access status.

blocked.reason: Only a collection-level description is supplied; no assignment can be identified or safely issued from it.
blocked.needed_to_unblock: An authorized later retrieval must identify each assignment, its files, permitted use, dependencies, and validator contract.

retrieval_policy.current_job: Use only the supplied snapshot and locally authored kickoff files. No network or source-repository retrieval is part of this preparation.
later_job_preconditions: Retrieval is explicitly authorized for that job.
The target is publicly accessible or credentials were legitimately supplied for the learner's own access.
Terms, license, and learner-view isolation permit storage or linking.
later_job_process: Start from the recorded course website URL; do not guess private or unpublished paths.
Record the final URL, retrieval timestamp, content hash, title, type, access result, and license or terms status for every item.
Keep source repositories read-only and copy permitted working material only into a per-attempt workspace.
Classify each item before proposing units; do not promote a link, collection, or failed retrieval automatically.
Preserve failed retrieval evidence and keep the corresponding material blocked.
Require a worker-harness-controlled validator before any added unit can be marked complete.
retrieval_policy.restricted_content: Never bypass authentication, paywalls, robots or access controls, and never expose secrets, hidden graders, sealed references, examiner material, or another learner's files.
retrieval_policy.fallback: If material remains unavailable, retain the blocked record and design only clearly labeled manager-authored alternatives; never reconstruct or claim the missing official content.
